title: LUNNOM LED bulb E26 150 lumen
description: LUNNOM LED bulb E26 150 lumen, globe clear Reminiscent of old filament bulbs but made with energy-saving LED. This clear bulb in a retro style spreads a warm white light and is perfect for lamps with a transparent or latticed shade. Illuminates at full power immediately when you turn the lamp on.
features: The light bulb can be used in temperatures from 0°F (-20°C) to 100°F (40°C).
Special waste handling may be required. Please contact your local authorities for more information.
The light from this LED bulb feels as strong as the light from a traditional 16W incandescent bulb.
Remember to choose a bulb that fits your lamp. Lamps usually have a large or small socket and our range has bulbs that fit in both types.
